newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soymeal weekly export sales highlights - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soymeal weekly export sales highlights - USDA.

text.p: USDA soymeal export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 100,000 MT were 30 percent below the previous week and 10 percent less than the 4-week average. Major increases for Greece (20,000 MT), the Philippines (20,000 MT), Croatia (15,000 MT), Spain (12,400 MT), and Slovenia (11,000 MT) were partially offset by reductions for unknown destinations (46,200 MT).
